The main issue of contention is the unprecedented commitment to maintaining the 1MB blocksize, which was never intended as anything more than a temporary spam protection, and which culminated in the catastrophic backlog, fee explosion, and abandonment by many major merchants including Microsoft. Their developers literally celebrate high fees, discourage people from actually using Bitcoin, and at least one wants to constrict capacity even further.
